notes.title: Post Next Fest bugs and improvements!
notes.content:
Once again, thank you everyone who played the demo during Steam Next Fest! Got a lot of great feedback! 

This update has a few quality of life improvements and a couple of bug fixes!

Bugs:
Scene Transitions:

 Fixed a bug that caused you to get stuck on a black screen if you exited the level immediately.

Control Deadzone on triggers:

 Fixed an issue where you had to almost fully hold in the triggers to get the forklift moving. You can now move much slower and more accurately when using a controller. This in turn also helped me improve the turning and handling of the forklift!


Features/QOL changes:
Respawn Button:

 Respawn buttons now require you to hold the button for 3 seconds in order to respawn. This will prevent accidental pushes of the button

Placement Zones:

 You can now take liftables out of the placement zones. Some players pointed out in the train level they were forced to restart.

World Map:

 Requested a lot haha, players will now appear outside of the level they just finished/exited
 Increased the speed of the forklift on the level selection, as some players pointed out the forklift seemed much slower with the zoomed out camera

notes.title: Bugs and Improvements!

notes.title: Forklift Freedom Update – Pick Up from Any Side!
notes.content:
After a lot of feedback on not being able to pick up liftables from all sides, I have done it. You can now pick up liftables from any side it falls on. No more waiting for liftables to respawn! Excited to see how some of the puzzles are dealt with now!

Hoping to get more updates and and sus out any more bugs before February Next Fest! Thanks again for all of the support!

notes.title: Some minor bugs and plenty of quality of life changes!
notes.content:
Huge shoutout to Indie Game Clinic  plus their viewers in the chat! and PlayMyGame for all the feedback and suggestions! I appreciate it so much!

Bugs:
Liftables:

 Fixed issue where some colliders had the wrong rotation

Tutorial:

 Fixed an issue where you could get stuck in the puzzle room if you pushed the pipe into the puzzle


Features/QOL changes:
Liftables:

 Liftables can now be picked up from any side! Noticed a lot of players trying to pick up the liftables from the wrong side. The pallets were definitely a main culprit of this. Now they can be picked up from any side, as long as the fork is close enough to the middle of the liftable

Tutorial:

 Updated text for liftables to say "Place Fork beneath center of liftable", some players were having issue picking up liftables
 Updated placement zone room to only require two liftables, going back to a previous room didn't make much sense in the tutorial for some players. I agree, never played a game where you had to go back in a tutorial
 Updated button to close gate if liftable was removed from it. This is the expectation in levels, so it should be the same in the tutorial

Farm:

 Made windmill and big barn transparent, it was obstructing player view
 Moved two of the bales from the field to the main area, moving 6 bales from the field and avoiding the harvesters is quite tedious and repetitive
 Replaced grain in middle of harvester field with a fence. It didn't make much sense for the grain growing to slow you down and this grain to stop you. "The same looking object shouldn't have two different properties"
 Made the top field smaller and added plants to the ground, as it was pretty barren and did not need to be that big
 Made the harvesters smaller, as well as their death zone. Noticed a lot of players were being killed outside of the fench

Levels:

 Reordered the levels so the Trainyard is after the Tutorial. The Farm is a big jump from the Tutorial. I felt like going from the Tutorial to the Trainyard is a much better transition and eases the player into the game

notes.title: Invisible walls, liftable bugs, and task completion updates
notes.content:
Bugs:
Liftables:

 Fixed a bug where during respawn the collider to make sure nothing is in the way had the wrong orientation
 Fixed a bug where liftables respawning didn't show the countdown anymore if you restarted the counter by interring with the respawn

Trainyard:

 Fixed invisible wall by the train that I accidentally cause haha


Quality of life changes:
Task Completion:

 Added a small delay after you finish the last task so it doesn't look like there are two items if the last task was placing a puzzle piece. ie: haybales

notes.title: New Logo, No Fly Zone, and Certification Notifications!
notes.content:
Bugs:
Forklift:

 Fixed a bug where forklift would continuing leaning when not moving
 Flying. Yes flying, there was a sneaky bug that would allow players to fly with their forklift. This is a no fly zone people!


Features/QOL changes:
Certification Notifications:

 Now when maxing out a certification, you will get a nice little notification at the bottom of your screen letting you know what certification you just completed

New Logo:

 After a lot of feedback from the community, it was made clear I should not be using an AI generated thumbnail. I reached out to some artists and ultimately ended up commissioning  Ahmedhilmi on Fiverr. They did an amazing job and I highly recommend them

notes.content:

Bugs:
Forklift:

 Fixed a bug where forklift kept leaning right quick when not moving

Dungeon:

 Fixed colliders on barrels, they were not active


Features/QOL changes:
Tutorial:

 Added checkpoints, so you now spawn in the last room you were in

Liftables:

 Removed default "Test" text from label, kept appearing sometimes

Farm:

 Removed colliders from side of truck, orientation of bale was making players think the bale could be placed in from the side

Dungeon:

 Removed a book shelf to make navigation easier in library

notes.title: More updates!
notes.content:
At the time of posting this the game has officially hit 100+ downloads and 50+ wishlists! Thank you so much to everyone who has played! Huge shoutout to everyone for all the feedback I've been receiving! It's really helping me learn how to improve the game and make it a better experience for everyone!

Also want to mention these streamers who played my game. Really helps to watch someone play and make notes of what could be improved! Please check out these streamers and support their channels:

Altune

CloverOhs

R1coScape
